barRaise.topFinding: Third consecutive run where the audit chain works and the release trigger does not. HEAD is still 4dd1546 from 2026-07-18 and the working tree carries three correct doc fixes across two files: the src/main.js v1.1.0 comment stamps (day 11), the PROJECT_SPEC.md icon entry (2026-07-24), and this morning blend entry from docs/drift-fixes-2026-07-25.md. Nothing blocks a release: both hard rules pass (no npm artifacts at root; pills agree at v1.1.2 across three locations) and all three node suites are green (9 integrity checks, 31/0 migration, 71/0 render). This run declined to run release.ps1 itself, deliberately, since a release pushes a public repo, mirrors into the live site, and posts to Discord, and the scheduled-task contract authorizes only the write actions the task file names; that makes the gap structural rather than accidental. New this run: PROJECT_SPEC.md section 4.1 is hand-maintained against data/herbs.json and drifted twice in two days by the same union-of-keys check (icon, then blend), so a test assertion belongs where an audit currently stands. Also one voice slip, two em dashes at PROJECT_SPEC.md:336 in a file the project voice scope covers. Health 83, verdict working, no BLOCK. Three findings chronic at runsOpen 8. The loop self-healed a dropped enqueue this run: yesterday stranded-tree finding had no queue item and the post-write gate caught it.
